name: Echo make it real pass ready for review
instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: Make-it-real pass is ready for review. Integrated Iron's subprocess run primitives, Ledger's SQLiteRepository, Beacon's live observer startup/configuration, and Echo's coordinator wiring for --database and --execute-runs. Current main includes real command builders, injectable subprocess RunManager, SQLite durable repository, live watchfiles observer startup through CLI flags, and service smoke tested with --database .agent-harness.db --observe-default-roots. Verification: uv run pytest -> 47 passed; OpenAPI YAML parses; service on 127.0.0.1:8876 returned /health ok; SQLite persistence survived restart for a smoke session. Latest commit before this TaskFlow note: e908598.
